title: TikTok for Business MCP Server changelog
content_data:
Stay up to date with the latest tools, schema updates, and improvements to TikTok for Business MCP Server.

```xtable
|Date{20%}|Type of change{20%}|Changes{60%}|
|---|---|---|
|October, 2026|Tool addition|We have introduced the `bc_create` tool, enabling users without an existing Business Center to create up to one self-serve Business Center for a direct advertiser. Creating a Business Center streamlines asset management tasks, such as ad account creation and sharing TikTok account access. Learn about[ the Available tools in TikTok for Business MCP Server](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/available-tools-in-tiktok-for-business-mcp-server/v1.3).|
|October, 2026|Tool addition|We have launched the A2A creative testing tool `tiktok_ads_creative_testing_agent`. Your hosting agent can now invoke this tool to create, manage, and review TikTok Ads creative tests within any existing ad group. Gain immediate access to data-grounded test plans, real-time progress updates, and comprehensive performance results without manual oversight. Streamline your decision-making process to confidently allocate budget toward high-potential creatives, optimizing your creative allocation strategy to drive sustained campaign success. Learn how to [test creatives using the creative testing agent](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/test-creatives-using-the-creative-testing-agent/v1.3).|
|October, 2026|Product enhancement|We have increased the rate limits for our MCP server from 3 queries per second (QPS) to 6 QPS. Utilizing this expanded limit helps reduce the likelihood of encountering throttling errors, ensuring a smoother execution path for your multi-step agent workflows.|
|October, 2026|Product enhancement|We now support using existing API tokens to authenticate MCP calls within custom agents. Compared to standard MCP tokens, this approach offers long-term authorization, granular permission controls, a streamlined setup process, and higher rate limits. To learn more, see [Authenticate MCP Server requests with an API access token in a custom agent](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/authenticate-mcp-server-requests-with-an-api-access-token-in-a-custom-agent/v1.3).|
|August, 2026|Tool addition|We have expanded the MCP server beyond existing API wrappers with our first Agent-to-Agent (A2A) tool: `tiktok_ads_diagnosis_agent`. Your hosting agent can now invoke this tool to troubleshoot performance issues for non-GMV Max ad accounts and receive actionable, natural-language insights directly from TikTok's official diagnosis models.|
|August, 2026|Product enhancement|We have launched [MCP Authorization endpoints](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/mcp-authorization/v1.3), empowering you to connect your custom agent directly to the TikTok for Business MCP server. This update allows your users to authorize and seamlessly leverage MCP-powered agentic workflows for enhanced efficiency. For detailed integration steps, see [How to connect a custom agent to TikTok for Business MCP Server](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/how-to-connect-a-custom-agent-to-tiktok-for-business-mcp-server/v1.3).|
|July, 2026|Product launch|We have introduced [TikTok for Business MCP Server](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/tiktok-ads-mcp-server/v1.3), giving you a direct bridge between AI agents and the TikTok Ads platform. From campaign creation and audience targeting to real-time bidding adjustments and performance reporting, agents can now execute the complete advertising workflow, boosting operational efficiency and unlocking new automation possibilities for your team.|
```
